features.name: Rage

effects.note: Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.
Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
If you are able to cast spells, you can't cast them or concentrate on them while raging.

features.summary: Advantage on Strength, +2 melee damage, and resistance to physical damage
features.text: On your turn, you can enter a rage as a bonus action. While raging, you gain the following benefits if you aren't wearing heavy armor: You have advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. When you make a melee weapon attack using Strength, you gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll. This bonus increases as you level. You have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. If you are able to cast spells, you can't cast them or concentrate on them while raging. Your rage lasts for 1 minute. It ends early if you are knocked unconscious, or if your turn ends and you haven't attacked a hostile creature since your last turn or taken damage since then. You can also end your rage on your turn as a bonus action. Once you have raged the maximum number of times for your barbarian level, you must finish a long rest before you can rage again. You may rage 2 times at 1st level, 3 at 3rd, 4 at 6th, 5 at 12th, and 6 at 17th.

features.name: Unarmored Defense

effects.note: While you are wearing no armor and not wielding a shield, your armor class equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Constitution modifier. This is replaced if your armor class would already be higher. You lose this benefit if you are knocked unconscious or if you use a shield.

features.summary: Without armor, AC becomes 10 plus Dex plus Con
features.text: While you are wearing no armor and not wielding a shield, your armor class equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Constitution modifier. You can use this feature if you are wearing any nonmagical armor that doesn't have a strength requirement, in which case your armor class equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Constitution modifier. This feature is replaced if your armor class would already be higher. You lose this benefit if you are knocked unconscious or if you use a shield.

features.name: Reckless Attack

effects.note: On your turn, you can forgo attacking and instead use the Dash or Disengage action, or, as part of a movement, you can approach a hostile creature within 5 feet of you. Until the start of your next turn, your attack bonus is +1, and the attack bonus of any attack you make against a creature that is not your intended target has disadvantage. This is not a substitution for your attack action.

features.summary: Sacrifice accuracy for +1 attack bonus, risking others' attacks
features.text: On your turn, you can forgo attacking and instead use the Dash or Disengage action, or, as part of a movement, you can approach a hostile creature that is within 5 feet of you. Until the start of your next turn, your attack bonus is increased by 1 for attack rolls made with Strength on your turn, and the attack bonus of any attack you make against a creature that is not your intended target has disadvantage. This is not a substitution for your attack action and does not count as an attack.

features.name: Danger Sense

effects.note: You have advantage on Dexterity (Initiative) and Strength (Perception) checks, which cover your avoiding or being noticed by hidden or moving creatures.

features.summary: Advantage on Initiative and Strength-based Perception
features.text: While you are not wearing heavy armor, you gain the following benefits: Your initiative bonus is increased by your Dexterity modifier. You gain advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on your hearing or your keen senses.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement

effects.note: When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature. The choice is permanent, as normal for an ability score increase.

features.summary: Raise one ability by 2, or two by 1
features.text: When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

features.name: Fast Movement

effects.note: Your walking speed increases by 10 feet if you aren't wearing heavy armor.
Your walking speed increases by 20 feet if you aren't wearing heavy armor.

features.summary: +10 ft walking speed without heavy armor, +20 at level 15
features.text: Your walking speed increases by 10 feet if you aren't wearing heavy armor.

features.name: Primal Protection

trigger.note: When you are wearing nonmagical armor and you are hit by an attack while you are raging.

effects.note: If you are wearing nonmagical armor and you are hit by an attack while you are raging, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage by 1. You gain the use of this feature again after a long rest.

features.summary: Reaction: reduce one hit by 1 while raging in nonmagical armor
features.text: If you are wearing nonmagical armor and you are hit by an attack while you are raging, you can use your reaction to take 1 less damage from that attack. You gain the use of this feature again after a long rest.

features.name: Frenzy

trigger.note: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack while raging.

effects.note: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack while raging, you can use a bonus action for 1 minute to gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with melee attacks that use Strength.

features.summary: While raging, +2 melee damage for a minute after hitting
features.text: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack while raging, you can use a bonus action for 1 minute to gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with melee attacks that use Strength.

features.name: Extra Attack

effects.note: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
You can attack three times, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
You can attack four times, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.summary: Two attacks with the Attack action, three at 11, four at 17
features.text: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Mindless Rage

effects.note: While raging, you are immune to the charmed and frightened conditions.

features.summary: Immune to charmed and frightened while raging
features.text: You have immunity to the charmed condition while raging. The charmed condition has no effect on you, and your IQ and personality are unaffected by it.

features.name: Brutal Critical

effects.note: While raging, you can roll one more weapon damage die a second time, adding it to the critical hit's damage.

features.summary: An extra damage die on critical hits while raging
features.text: While raging, you can roll one more weapon damage die a second time, adding it to the critical hit's damage. You can use this feature to make only one attack that uses the effect.

features.name: Indomitable

effects.note: When you fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to automatically succeed on it instead. You gain the use of this feature again after a long rest.

features.summary: Reaction: automatically succeed on a failed save
features.text: When you fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to automatically succeed on it instead. You gain the use of this feature again after a long rest.

features.name: Feral Instinct
features.text: While your rage is active, you have advantage on Intelligence checks.

features.name: Primal Knowledge
features.summary: Gain one skill of your choice as a barbarian skill
features.text: Your number of skills is equal to your Intelligence modifier plus your level. In addition, you gain proficiency in one skill of your choice that is not already a barbarian skill.

features.name: Relentless Rage

effects.note: While raging, you can concentrate on as many of the effects of the Reckless Attack feature as you like.

features.summary: No longer need to concentrate on Reckless Attack while raging
features.text: While raging, you can concentrate on as many of the effects of the Reckless Attack feature as you like.

features.name: Persistent Rage

effects.note: Your rage doesn't end if you are knocked unconscious, but it does end if you are incapacitated (as the definition of the condition states).

features.summary: Rage no longer ends when knocked unconscious
features.text: Your rage doesn't end if you are knocked unconscious, but it does end if you are incapacitated (as the definition of the condition states).

features.name: Indomitable Might
features.summary: +1 to Constitution saving throws while raging
features.text: While raging, your saving throw bonus for Constitution saving throws is increased by 1.

features.name: Primal Champion

effects.note: Your number of skills is equal to your Intelligence modifier plus your level, and you can select one feat of your choice, which you can gain at 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level. You gain the benefits of a second feat of your choice, which you can gain at 20th level.

features.summary: Gain two feats, the second at 20th level
features.text: Your number of skills is equal to your Intelligence modifier plus your level. In addition, you can select one feat of your choice, which you can gain at 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level. You gain the benefits of a second feat of your choice, which you can gain at 20th level.
